title: Rice Cakes with Cream Cheese and Blueberries
excerpt: A crunchy, quick and delicious snack that combines puffed rice cakes, creamy cream cheese and the freshness of high-mountain blueberries. Perfect to calm a craving at any hour.
imageAlt: Puffed rice cakes topped with soft cream cheese, fresh Fresh Pick blueberries and a drizzle of honey.

ingredients.text: 2 tablespoons sliced almonds or chopped walnuts

steps: Get the puffed rice cakes ready and place them on a clean board or serving plate.
Spread a generous tablespoon of cream cheese over the surface of each rice cake with a spatula or knife.
Carefully rinse and gently dry the Fresh Pick blueberries. Grown in the high mountains of Guasca, these berries have the perfect sweetness to contrast with the creaminess of the cheese.
Arrange the blueberries over the cream cheese layer, pressing just a little so they stay in place.
Finish by decorating with the sliced almonds and a gentle drizzle of honey right before serving.
tips: Assemble the rice cakes right when you are about to eat to make sure they stay nice and crunchy and don’t get soggy.
To better preserve your leftover Fresh Pick blueberries, store them in the fridge in their original packaging, unwashed, and wash them only right before eating.
